note: Variant lanes for VR Forge. A lane is a named library set a brief can be pinned to. Raw WebXR is a lane like any other, not 'the original' — the control cell has to be in the grid to be comparable.

lanes.label: Three.js + WebXR add-ons
lanes.note: The Quest 3 default: modern ES-module Three.js with VRButton, controller/hand model factories and XRPlanes, copied into the project.

lanes.label: Three.js + Rapier
lanes.note: Adds WASM rigid-body physics for grabbing, throwing and stacking.

lanes.label: Three.js + Tone.js
lanes.note: Adds synthesis and musical scheduling for instruments and rhythm work.

lanes.label: Raw WebXR
lanes.note: No library at all: hand-written WebGL2 and the WebXR Device API. The control cell — everything a framework normally hides has to be written out.
